description: Delegates the mail subdomain (mail.<domain>) to Harmony's DNS so Harmony can manage SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX for that subdomain only. The main domain, website and existing email are not changed.
variableDescription: ns1, ns2: the first label of the two Cloudflare nameservers assigned to the mail subdomain zone, e.g. 'ada' for ada.ns.cloudflare.com.
